summary: In "1 Undervalued Dividend Stock You Can Buy and Hold Forever," published 8 Oct 2026, Parkevtate Vosianc CFA reiterates his PepsiCo case: PEP — BUY @ ~$125 (reiterated, no flip; prior BUY was 2026-09-29 @ $128). His DCF fair value of $178 implies ~40% upside, and Pepsi trades at its cheapest forward P/E (14x) in years. Headwinds named: war-driven demand drop, fuel costs, and the long-term consumer shift toward healthier choices. The digest excerpt bundles a same-day summary of Mark Roussin CPA's "3 Stocks with MASSIVE Upside," a separate video whose thesis is not chasing anything at all-time highs but "getting paid to wait" via Dec 18 cash-secured puts. Roussin's calls there (not attributed to Parkevtate's video): CRDO — CONDITIONAL_BUY via selling the Dec 18 $150 put (~$500 premium, effective basis ~$145; stock ~$220; FY revenue tripled to $1.3B, net income 5x, Street avg $270); GOOGL — CONDITIONAL_BUY via selling the Dec 18 $300 put (~$400 premium; stock ~$350; his largest, highest-conviction holding, not adding at $350); AMD — CONDITIONAL_BUY via selling the Dec 18 $450 put (~$440 premium; stock ~$633 at ATHs; long-term extremely bullish, calls $1,000 within 12–18 months, Q revenue $11.5B +50%, DC revenue $6.7B +100%).
